response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced full-stack/web software engineer with broad language exposure, but his background shows essentially no alignment with the core requirements of this role: no native Japanese proficiency, no evidence of Linux kernel source modification, no embedded/networking security experience (MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF, SNMP), and his primary languages are TypeScript/JavaScript/DLang rather than C for UNIX systems development. The mismatch spans both the hard language requirement and the deep technical domain expertise required.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software development experience across many stacks
Some early C/C++ experience (National Instruments, Sound Position Server on Linux)
Strong self-driven learner with public speaking, open-source, and workshop leadership experience
concerns: No native or apparent Japanese language proficiency, which is a hard requirement
No demonstrated experience with Linux kernel investigation/modification or embedded firmware
No experience with required security/networking domains (MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF, SNMP, switch chips)

key_factors.factor: Lack of embedded/security networking domain experience
